# Find Homes Around Denver

> Real estate guides, calculators and market insights for central Denver and Greenwood Village from Chris Nowakiwsky, Broker Associate with The Real Estate Experts at RE/MAX Professionals (10111 Inverness Main St, Suite P, Englewood, CO 80112; (970) 485-2228; chris.nowakiwsky@remax.net; Colorado license #100090898).

Chris has 10 years in the real estate industry, starting with RE/MAX in 2016, and helps move-up families, relocators and first-time buyers buy and sell in Washington Park, Platt Park, Bonnie Brae, Belcaro, Cory-Merrill, South Park Hill, Capitol Hill, Sloan Lake and Greenwood Village.

## Guides

- [About Chris Nowakiwsky](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/about/): Chris Nowakiwsky is a Broker Associate on The Real Estate Experts team at RE/MAX Professionals, with 10 years in the real estate industry. Colorado native, 5.0-rated on Google and Zillow.
- [Living in Belcaro, Denver](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/belcaro/): Living in Belcaro, Denver: large lots, ranch homes and custom builds between Washington Park and Cherry Creek, the Cherry Creek Trail, and honest pros and cons from local agent Chris Nowakiwsky.
- [Living in Bonnie Brae, Denver](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/bonnie-brae/): Living in Bonnie Brae, Denver: a 1920s planned neighborhood of curving streets, period homes, Bonnie Brae Park and the tavern, with honest pros and cons from local agent Chris Nowakiwsky.
- [How to Buy a Home in Denver](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/buy/): A Denver buyer's guide for 2026: how to use today's negotiating room, the Colorado buying process step by step, inspections for older homes, closing costs, and a monthly payment calculator.
- [Living in Capitol Hill, Denver](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/capitol-hill/): Buying a condo or townhome in Capitol Hill, Denver: historic buildings, HOA questions to ask, parking and what to know before you buy, from local owner and agent Chris Nowakiwsky.
- [Living in Cory-Merrill, Denver](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/cory-merrill/): Living in Cory-Merrill, Denver: quiet streets east of Washington Park, two neighborhood schools, post-war ranches and new custom homes, with honest pros and cons from local agent Chris Nowakiwsky.
- [First-Time Home Buyer Guide for Denver](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/first-time-buyers/): Buying your first home in Denver: how much you need upfront, Colorado down payment assistance from CHFA and metroDPA, the 3-3-3 rule, what to check before buying a condo, and a cash-to-close calculator.
- [Living in Greenwood Village, Colorado](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/greenwood-village/): Living in Greenwood Village, Colorado: estate lots, Cherry Creek schools, the High Line Canal trail and a short commute to the Tech Center, with honest pros and cons from local agent Chris Nowakiwsky.
- [Insights](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/market/): Denver real estate insights from Chris Nowakiwsky: monthly market updates, seller and buyer tips, and neighborhood spotlights for central Denver and Greenwood Village.
- [Moving to Denver: A Relocation Guide](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/moving-to-denver/): Moving to Denver in 2026: which neighborhoods fit which lifestyles, taxes and cost of living, schools and DPS SchoolChoice, altitude and weather, getting around, and a new-resident checklist.
- [Denver Neighborhood Guides](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/neighborhoods/): Compare Washington Park, Platt Park, Bonnie Brae, Belcaro, Cory-Merrill, South Park Hill, Sloan Lake, Capitol Hill and Greenwood Village: homes, feel, who each fits and what to know before you buy.
- [Living in Platt Park, Denver](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/platt-park/): Living in Platt Park, Denver: South Pearl Street, bungalows and Denver Squares, light rail, schools and honest pros and cons from local agent Chris Nowakiwsky of RE/MAX Professionals.
- [How to Sell and Buy a Home at the Same Time](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/sell-and-buy/): Sell first, buy first, or make a contingent offer? How each option works in Colorado, how to fund your down payment, a step-by-step timeline, and a move-up budget calculator.
- [How to Sell Your Home in Denver](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/sell/): A Denver seller's guide for 2026: what today's market means for pricing, prep that pays in older homes, Colorado closing costs and taxes, the listing-to-closing timeline, and a net proceeds calculator.
- [Living in Sloan Lake, Denver](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/sloan-lake/): Living in Sloan Lake, Denver: the city's second-largest park, a 2.6-mile lake loop, bungalows and new builds, with honest pros and cons from local agent Chris Nowakiwsky of RE/MAX Professionals.
- [Living in South Park Hill, Denver](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/south-park-hill/): Living in South Park Hill, Denver: tree-lined parkways, classic brick homes, City Park next door and an easy airport run, with honest pros and cons from local agent Chris Nowakiwsky.
- [Living in Washington Park, Denver](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/washington-park/): Living in Washington Park, Denver: homes, prices, schools, the park, and honest pros and cons from local agent Chris Nowakiwsky of RE/MAX Professionals.

## Insights

- [Denver Real Estate Market Update: October 2026](https://findhomesarounddenver.com/denver-market-update-october-2026/): Denver's housing market in October 2026: inventory at its highest September level since 2011, more price cuts, homes over $1M selling faster, and what it means for buyers and sellers.
